jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p>We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.</p> <p>Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.</li> <li>Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data</li> <li>Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.</li> <li>Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines</li> <li>Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems</li> <li>Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.</li> <li>Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field</li> <li>3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.</li> <li>Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.</li> <li>Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.</li> <li>Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.</li> <li>Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.</li> <li>Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.</li> <li>Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration.&nbsp;</li> <li>Agentic AI-assisted development experience.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.</li> <li>Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/">https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>401k with Employer Match</li> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support</li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency:</strong></p> <p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p> <p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit <a href="https://www.redditinc.com/careers/" target="_blank">https://www.redditinc.com/careers/</a>.</p> <p>To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.</p></div><div class="title">The base salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$164,200</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$229,990 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.&nbsp; We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.&nbsp; We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.&nbsp; For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.&nbsp; Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div>

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About The Role The role owns the data infrastructure that powers analytics and product decisions across the organization - building reliable batch and streaming pipelines that move tens of millions of events daily from source systems into a modern cloud warehouse. The Data Engineer will work closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, and product teams to model data, enforce quality standards, and reduce the time between raw event capture and business-ready insight. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or dbt Cloud Develop and optimize data models in Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks, balancing query performance, storage cost, and maintainability Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and observability tooling to catch pipeline failures and schema drift before they hit downstream consumers Build streaming and near-real-time ingestion pipelines using Kafka, Kinesis, or Flossom-equivalent event streaming technologies Partner with analytics engineers to define semantic layers, dimensional models, and documented data contracts for core business entities Optimize warehouse costs and pipeline performance through partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, and query tuning Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices for data assets using Terraform, GitHub Actions, and version-controlled dbt projects What We Are Looking For 3-6 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or backend engineering with significant data infrastructure ownership Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills, including writing production-grade, tested pipeline code Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks) and orchestration tooling (Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) Experience with one or more cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure, including storage (S3, GCS) and compute services Solid grasp of data modeling techniques - dimensional modeling, Kimball methodologies, and event-based schemas Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Bonus: Experience with streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink), data cataloging/lineage tools (dbt docs, Monte Carlo, Amundsen), or having built data platforms from early-stage maturity

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on. We are now hiring a Data Analyst, based in Austin. You will turn our data into decisions. You will analyze how customers use the product, measure the quality of what our AI delivers and give product, sales and leadership the insights they need. Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it. What you bring: - A few years of experience in data analysis, or a strong academic background in a quantitative field. - Strong SQL, and experience with Python or a similar language for analysis. - The ability to turn a vague question into a clear answer. What you get: - A founding role with real ownership. - A senior team that has scaled companies before. - The chance to shape how a company understands itself. To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself. If you know someone who should read this, send it to them.
